g.text: Settings | Global preferences, appearance, storage, and app behavior | Local
State: Unsaved changes | Save (s) or Revert (r) — switching categories keeps this draft.
Collapse large pasted chunks only when they exceed the threshold.
Normal typing stays literal. The canonical message payload is preserved.
Render images linked in assistant replies (remote fetch).
Off by default: fetching a model-suggested link reveals your IP address to that host.
How much of an agent tool result the Console shows you here -- distinct from max_tool_result_chars,
which caps what the model itself saw. Open a run's "View full log" (Agent rail) to read everything
Used when no provider+model profile or active Console session overrides them.
Save: staged - press s to save, r
Reasoning and thinking controls are sent only to providers that support them.
